algotransparency.title: How the algorithm works
algotransparency.intro: In accordance with the Digital Services Act (the EU regulation on digital services), here are the main parameters that determine the content you see on Nexus, and how to change them.
algotransparency.foryou_p: This feed ranks posts by several factors. Here is their approximate relative weight:
algotransparency.f_follow_desc: Posts from people you follow are highlighted.
algotransparency.f_fresh_desc: Recent posts come before older ones.
algotransparency.f_engage_desc: The likes and comments a post gets increase its visibility.
algotransparency.f_interests_desc: The hashtags and topics you interact with guide the suggestions.
algotransparency.chrono_body: You have the right to a non-personalized feed. The « Following » tab on Home shows only posts from accounts you follow, in chronological order, with no algorithmic ranking.
algotransparency.trends_body: Trends reflect the most-used hashtags over the last 24 hours, weighted by the number of posts and likes. They refresh automatically: no manual editorial choice.
algotransparency.ads_body: Ads shown are non-personalized by default: they are not based on profiling your behavior. They only appear after your cookie consent.
algotransparency.notuse_body: No profiling based on sensitive data (political opinions, religion, orientation, health). You can turn off algorithmic suggestions in Settings → Privacy.
